import pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.common.exceptions import NoAlertPresentException, TimeoutException
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

src = pathlib.Path('/app/out.html').read_text()
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.html', delete=False) as f:
    f.write(src); p = pathlib.Path(f.name)
subprocess.run(['python','/app/filter.py',str(p)], check=True)
o=Options(); o.add_argument('--headless'); o.add_argument('--no-sandbox'); o.add_argument('--disable-dev-shm-usage'); o.add_argument('--disable-gpu'); o.binary_location='/usr/bin/chromium'
d=webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'), options=o)
try:
    d.get('file://' + str(p))
    a=WebDriverWait(d,5).until(EC.alert_is_present())
    text=a.text
    a.accept()
    print({'alert': True, 'text': text, 'filtered_contains_meta': 'meta' in p.read_text().lower()})
finally:
    d.quit(); p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
PY

arguments.command:
set -e
rm -rf /app/povray-2.2
mkdir -p /app/povray-2.2
cp -a /tmp/povzip/. /app/povray-2.2/
mkdir -p /app/povray-2.2/povdoc/include /app/povray-2.2/povdoc/demo /app/povray-2.2/povdoc/docs
cd /app/povray-2.2/povdoc
7z x -y ../POVDOC.ZIP >/tmp/povdoc_extract.log
# Normalize legacy uppercase archive paths into the requested include layout.
for f in INCLUDE/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp -f "$f" ../povdoc/include/; done
for f in DEMO/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp -f "$f" ../povdoc/demo/; done
for f in DOCS/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp -f "$f" ../povdoc/docs/; done
cd /app/povray-2.2
printf 'POV-Ray source archive: POV22F.ZIP\nArchive origin: Internet Archive item OS2_The_Most_Complete_Collection_Powersource, GRAPHICS/POV22F.ZIP\nArchive SHA256: '; sha256sum /tmp/povextract/POV22F.ZIP | cut -d' ' -f1
printf 'Documentation archive: POVDOC.ZIP\nDocumentation SHA256: '; sha256sum POVDOC.ZIP | cut -d' ' -f1
printf 'Source version evidence: '; grep -a -m1 'Version 2.2' README.1ST
printf 'Source files: '; find source -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l
printf 'Include files: '; find povdoc/include -type f | wc -l

def solve(counts, z0):

 def fun(z):
  # logits probabilities via softmax among groups weighted counts? z raw log p, norm equation
  p=np.exp(np.clip(z,-745,100))
  norm=np.dot(c,p)
  p=p/norm
  f=np.dot(c,p*np.log(n*p))-target
  b=-np.dot(c,np.log(n*p))/n-target
  return [norm-1, f, b] # bad scales

 def f2(z):
  lp=z-np.max(z); p0=np.exp(lp); p=p0/np.dot(c,p0)
  return [np.dot(c,p*np.log(n*p))-target, -np.dot(c,np.log(n*p))/n-target]
 r=least_squares(f2,np.array(z0,float), max_nfev=3000, xtol=1e-14, ftol=1e-14, gtol=1e-14)
 z=r.x; p0=np.exp(z-np.max(z)); p=p0/np.dot(c,p0)
 return r.cost,r.optimality,p,f2(z)
for m in [1,10,100,1000,10000,50000,100000,149998]:
 counts=[1,m,n-1-m]
 best=None

  z0=np.sort(np.random.uniform(-25,5,3))[::-1]
  ans=solve(counts,z0)
  if best is None or ans[0]<best[0]:best=ans
 print(m,best[0],best[2],best[3])

set -eu
rm -rf /tmp/final-latex-check
mkdir -p /tmp/final-latex-check
cp main.tex input.tex /tmp/final-latex-check/
cd /tmp/final-latex-check
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error main.tex > pdflatex.log 2>&1
pdflatex_status=$?

base=open('input.tex').read()
cands={
'curious':['inquisitive','interested','odd','peculiar'],
'unsought':['unwanted','uninvited','unrequested','undesired','spontaneous'],
'riotous':['wild','unruly','chaotic','boisterous','tumultuous'],
'excursions':['trips','outings','journeys','expeditions','adventures'],
'responsiveness':['sensitivity','awareness','reaction','attentiveness'],
'creative':['imaginative','inventive','artistic'],
'temperament':['disposition','nature','character','personality','mood'],
'weatherbeaten':['worn','battered','deteriorated'],
'pathfinder':['pioneer','trailblazer','scout']}

    print(word, val, 'exit',p.returncode,'overfull',n)

set -eu
root=$(pwd)
rm -rf /tmp/final-latex-check
mkdir -p /tmp/final-latex-check
cp "$root/main.tex" "$root/input.tex" /tmp/final-latex-check/
cd /tmp/final-latex-check
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error main.tex > pdflatex.log 2>&1
pdflatex_status=$?
overfull_count=$(grep -ic 'overfull \\hbox' pdflatex.log || true)
main_hash=$(sha256sum "$root/main.tex" | cut -d' ' -f1)
syn_hash=$(sha256sum "$root/synonyms.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
# Reconstruct the pre-edit input from the final file using exactly the six recorded substitutions.
sed -e 's/inquisitive/curious/g' -e 's/wild/riotous/g' -e 's/sensitivity/responsiveness/g' -e 's/imaginative temperament/creative temperament/g' -e 's/worn cardboard bungalow/weatherbeaten cardboard bungalow/g' -e 's/pioneer/pathfinder/g' input.tex > reconstructed-original.tex
original_hash=$(sha256sum reconstructed-original.tex | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ "$original_hash" = "7bf7dbe58dbbfb08b6a652c547daa09a57cdbccc0fd18141b4968756061326a3" ]; then synonym_only=1; else synonym_only=0; fi
if [ "$main_hash" = "6c07d3203fdc3fc54317fafeee9d19b576418c9de2e142a599814b2f6cb32b2f" ]; then main_unchanged=1; else main_unchanged=0; fi
if [ "$syn_hash" = "bc8f7cf4b41914be036e6d4666e1550971d39f4bdb387be6" ]; then synonyms_unchanged=1; else synonyms_unchanged=0; fi
printf '{"pdflatex_exit":%s,"overfull_hbox_count":%s,"synonym_only":%s,"main_unchanged":%s,"synonyms_unchanged":%s}\n' "$pdflatex_status" "$overfull_count" "$synonym_only" "$main_unchanged" "$synonyms_unchanged"

import re
from collections import Counter
f=open('image.ppm','rb'); f.readline(); w,h=map(int,f.readline().split()); f.readline()
data=iter(map(int,re.findall(rb'\d+',f.read())))
# samples grid and bbox non-sky-ish
pts=[]; cnt=Counter(); minx=w;maxx=0;miny=h;maxy=0
for y in range(h):
 for x in range(w):
  r,g,b=next(data); cnt[(r//8,g//8,b//8)]+=1
  if r>g*1.15 and r>b*0.8 and r>80:
   minx=min(minx,x);maxx=max(maxx,x);miny=min(miny,y);maxy=max(maxy,y)
print(w,h,'bbox red',minx,maxx,miny,maxy,'top',cnt.most_common(12))
# rows unique runs sampled every 100
f.close()
